nodes.label: Swarm Create Table

nodes.label: Swarm Rows Aggregation
nodes.rationale: Use rows() + plain JS to count/filter/summarize, no subagents for aggregation

nodes.label: Swarm Run Dispatch
nodes.rationale: Dispatch instruction template across rows, merge results, return completed/failed/skipped
